csv_scope_of_work: The State of Pennsylvania, Department of Transporation, ,may be seeking a consultant to provide the CI for SR 2016-01B Bridge Inspection. The Department will retain an engineering firm to provide a supplementary construction inspection staff of approximately one (1) Transportation Construction Manager, two (2) Transportation Construction Inspector Supervisors, two (2) Transportation Construction Inspectors and two (2) Technical Assistants. Transportation Construction Managers, Transportation Construction Inspector Supervisors, and Transportation Construction Inspectors should have NECEPT, ACI/PennDOT Concrete Certification to perform the job duties. All Inspection staff should have CDS/ V3 and mobile knowledge and understanding to do the documentation work. Structure experience is preferred for ECMS #10527. These projects are in Engineering District 5-0. ECMS #10527 & 110318

title: Construction Inspection for SR 2016-01B Bridge Inspection
short_description: PennDOT seeks supplemental inspection staff for a bridge construction inspection project in Pennsylvania.
project_scope: Supplementary construction inspection services for bridge-related projects in PennDOT Engineering District 5-0, including ECMS #10527 and #110318 for SR 2016-01B / SR 12-04S. The assignment covers staffing of approximately 1 Transportation Construction Manager, 2 Transportation Construction Inspector Supervisors, 2 Transportation Construction Inspectors, and 2 Technical Assistants. Structure experience is preferred.
services: Construction inspection services, including supplementary inspection staffing for bridge works; requested disciplines include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, construction/project management, inspection services, materials testing, structural engineering, and traffic design engineering. Required certifications include NECEPT and ACI/PennDOT Concrete Certification; staff should also have CDS/V3 and mobile documentation knowledge.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a construction inspection staffing assignment, not a structural design or planning mandate.
- No clear scope for bridge design, structural concept development, or engineering innovation.
- Bridge-related project, which gives slight relevance to sbp's bridge expertise.
- Structure experience is only preferred, and the tender focuses on inspection personnel and certifications.
- Falls close to pure inspection/project management services, which are generally low priority for sbp.
fee_explanation: No explicit fee information is provided. The notice only states supplementary inspection staffing requirements and a total construction cost of 16.5 million USD.
references_qualifications: Transportation Construction Managers, Transportation Construction Inspector Supervisors, and Transportation Construction Inspectors should have NECEPT and ACI/PennDOT Concrete Certification. All inspection staff should have CDS/V3 and mobile documentation knowledge. Structure experience is preferred for ECMS #10527.
